newsitem.title: USA: BankBoston tab Callahan to high yield post.
newsitem.headline: BankBoston tab Callahan to high yield post.

text.p: BankBoston Corp said Friday it hired Paul Callahan, formerly of Nomura Securities International, to be managing director of high yield sales.

Callahan, who will report to Steven Shenfeld, managing director and head of high yield securities, will be responsible for selling high yield debt securities to a variety of institutional investors as an integral part of BankBoston's high yield effort.

BankBoston said that when it receives Federal Reserve Board approval for a securities subsidiary operating under Section 20 of the Glass-Steagall law, it will be able to provide a full menu of leveraged financing options, including high yield debt securities, to its corporate client base.
Before joining BankBoston, Callahan spent four years with Nomura in New York, most recently as director of high yield sales.
